title: M5Stack Stamp-P4 · S013
summary: ESP32-P4 微型模块，16MB Flash、32MB PSRAM，提供 USB、MIPI 与扩展引脚；此模型使用官方 footprint 内嵌的板级 STEP，P4 运行内核尚未接入。
assemblyNotes: Official Stamp-P4 KiCad footprint contains a base64+zstd STEP payload. Container receipt, KiCad V1 MurmurHash checksum and decompressed SHA-256 are retained. All213 solids and3 otherwise-orphaned USB shells are included in source-native millimetres. Translation only centers the assembly; no geometry scaling. STEP component reference labels/board layout belong to CAD V0.3 dated2025-11-26, not an inferred user hardware revision.

facts.label: Manufacturer board CAD
facts.value: StampP4_PCB_main_V0.3_20251126.step embedded in the official KiCad footprint;213solids+3openUSB shells
facts.notes: Open USB shells are included; a solids-only export would incorrectly omit the connector and understate length/depth.

facts.label: STEP original visual attributes
facts.notes: Read through native XCAF GetColor/Search, not inferred from part names. Missing attributes remain null in the source plan.

limitations: Runtime ESP32-P4/board model is not implemented; geometry and firmware compatibility are independent.
Manufacturer board geometry is available, so no invented UNKNOWN board replaces it. Exact circuitry behavior, copper stackup, silkscreen completeness are not certified.
No shell exists on this bare module. Shell recoloring is inapplicable; board/component materials remain separate.
OpenCascade tessellation .05mm linear/.2rad angular is approximate; raw sourceSTEP remains authoritative.
Official photos may represent later revisions; user hardware revision remains unknown.
Manufacturer CAD retains its repository license; official product photographs are not relicensed under projectMIT.
No physical measurement or flashing performed.

XCAF source colors are applied to the33 components with a native color. The remaining183 components use neutral display colors; these are not measured or claimed as manufacturer material colors.75 source names are retained separately from stable renderer IDs.
